items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: Then I got one of them old one by Dale, one of them card books.

ctx.x: Then I got one of them old one by Dale, one of them card books. This is a part of it. I think I got that in around the 30s, Sam Lee. Yeah, by the cards. I'm trying to... That's the one I was really looking for. Show you how to build all the cards by Dale. Yeah, they don't make no more books like that. We had seven cards.
Yeah, give you all the cards.
